affinity.notes: Prominent blue-white lightning and storm clouds make the electric affinity unmistakable.

anatomy.notes: Humanoid upper body, streaming garments, and vaporous lower form read clearly as a djinn.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "mobile ranged caster" does not semantically communicate Ring-Vector Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Extended casting arm and directional lightning rings clearly telegraph a ranged discharge.

finish.notes: Armor, cloth, smoke, and electrical effects are richly and consistently rendered.

framing.notes: Dynamic diagonal pose remains centered with the main body fully visible.

identity.notes: Blind perception "storm djinn" semantically identifies djinn/djinn-djinn.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "high" is outside the accepted set for intended T3.
